question: What claim about dissolution is being pressed when a request is made to tell all of that to the speaker?
premises: A question is asked in what the dissolution occurs.
It is stated that something goes to dissolution.
A request is made to tell all of that to the speaker.
inference: The speaker seeks a full account of that into which dissolution takes place.
uncertainties: The referent of tat+sarvaṃ is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: And indeed, into what does it go to dissolution? Tell me all of that.
